name: The Winter Wedding
source:
This winter is unlike any other. 

There are only 10 days left until your wedding. 

Your life is about to change forever... 

You can already feel the shift, as extraordinary events refuse to leave you in peace while the tension rises. 

Walking the fine line between reality and illusion, you find yourself surrounded by darkness and sinister secrets. 

Can you survive your wedding? 

Will you escape this labyrinth and find true love?

[From [url=https://devilinlovegames.itch.io/the-winter-wedding]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这个冬天与往常不同。

距离你的婚礼只剩下10天了。

你的生活即将永远改变…… 

你已经可以感受到这种转变，因为当紧张局势加剧时，非凡的事件不会让你平静下来。

游走在现实与幻象之间，你会发现自己被黑暗和险恶的秘密所包围。

你能在婚礼上安然度过吗？

你会逃离这个迷宫并找到真爱吗？

[来自[url=https://devilinlovegames.itch.io/the-winter-wedding]itch.io[/url]]
